name: Inpatient Mortality EMR Benchmark
description: A multicenter retrospective evaluation comparing models for predicting inpatient mortality using electronic medical record time-series and tabular data.
typical_sota_score: ≈0.80–0.95 AUROC (varies by cohort, feature set, and model)
reputation: Widely used clinical benchmark for EHR-based inpatient mortality prediction in research; moderate adoption in medical ML studies.
notes: Class imbalance and dataset shift across hospitals; privacy/PHI concerns and need for careful external validation; non-LLM benchmark.
